gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-onest: Sprawling, uniform lettering: Bushcraft spaces its characters far apart and barely separates capitals from lowercase. Onest brings short ascenders over big bowls, and a modest body size is enough to let its open shapes breathe.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-oxygen: Extra-wide spacing sets Bushcraft apart, with closed letters and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. But Oxygen, its curves never closing back on themselves, loosens the mood, so the two feel artistic above and relaxed below.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-preahvihear: Expressive and wide-set, Bushcraft leads with closed, sealed-looking letters. Preahvihear, plain sans with mouths opened like a pried oyster shell and a lofty x-height, gives that heading room to breathe on the page.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-savate: Wide-spaced, sign-plain and sealed shut, that is Bushcraft at a glance. The heading is best at making a statement, while Savate, sans-serif with sturdy hairlines and open jaws on every curve, does the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-sen: Sen stands tall, a sans traced in a constant-weight line. Bushcraft is best at wide-spaced, closed-letter flair, while Sen's curves end before turning inward, which does the steady job of carrying words.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-sofia-sans: Artistic and widely spaced, Bushcraft draws each curve without any swell. Its job is expressive display, while Sofia Sans, plain sans with no stroke modulation, stands tall like cut stencil pieces and handles the everyday text.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-vend-sans: Bushcraft sprawls wide, its closed letters barely separating capitals from lowercase. It excels at expressive display, while Vend Sans, plain sans with ruler-drawn lines and wide, unclosed terminals, fills the line and does the reading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi reads easily, its e opening clearly to the right. Paragraphs in this outsized sans-serif would flow without snagging, while Bushcraft, closed and widely spaced, is better kept for expressive display.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-abeezee: A towering x-height gives Capture It its urban, commanding stance. ABeeZee, plain sans with terminals ending well away from the stem, makes paragraphs feel friendly and unhurried beside it.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-aldrich: Capture It is urban and commanding, with letters that feel nearly sealed under a towering x-height. Aldrich, plain sans with cupped rounds, brings the sharpest quality of all, a single thick thread tracing every letter.
